race.description: Club Sydney The Amazing Ben Hall Bullet Hcp (Bm82)
race.comment: MICRO MIKKI (2) is back after a 14-week spell. Last appeared when successful over 1300m at Narromine against open class sprinters. Not a noted first-up performer but off the brief break there may be enough residual fitness to get her through.  ATMOSPHERIC ROCK (7) has savaged the line to fill minor placings at his last two outings, both on the Canberra Acton circuit. In the mix if he can bring that form to the turf. ZOUTASTIC (4) comes into this third-up after two modest efforts in far stronger races. Usually peaks at this stage of the prep so watch for a spike in form. MARVEL MAN (11) was okay first-up and should come on from that. Hasn't been this light in quite some time.
